name: violao-diario
description: Violão Diário: o mesmo index.html publicado como site (PWA) e como app nativo Android e iOS via Capacitor.

scripts.android: npm run sync && cap open android
scripts.ios: npm run sync && cap open ios
scripts.apk: npm run sync && node scripts/android-build.mjs debug
scripts.apk:release: npm run sync && node scripts/android-build.mjs release
scripts.aab: npm run sync && node scripts/android-build.mjs bundle
scripts.test: node scripts/check-syntax.mjs index.html && node scripts/check-data.mjs index.html
